description: This file contains unit tests for the gesture handling functionality of the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app. It tests various swipe gestures and their configurable actions, ensuring correct behavior and integration with user preferences.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardGesturesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the gesture actions and their configurability in the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app.

methods.name: setUpForAnySoftKeyboardBase
methods.description: Initial setup method that enables a specific keyboard add-on and calls the superclass setup.

methods.name: testSwipeLeftFromBackSpace
methods.description: Tests that a swipe left gesture from the backspace key deletes a character and maintains the same keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeRightFromBackSpace
methods.description: Tests that a swipe right gesture from the backspace key deletes a character and maintains the same keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeLeft
methods.description: Verifies that a swipe left from a key switches to the symbols keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeRight
methods.description: Verifies that a swipe right from a key switches to a specific numeric keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeWithSpaceOutput
methods.description: Checks that swiping right with space output configured results in space or period insertion.

methods.name: testSwipeLeftFromSpace
methods.description: Tests that swiping left from space returns to the symbols keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeRightFromSpace
methods.description: Tests that swiping right from space switches to the numeric keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeUp
methods.description: Verifies that an upward swipe toggles shift state on the current keyboard.

methods.name: testSwipeDown
methods.description: Verifies that a downward swipe hides the keyboard view.

methods.name: testSwipeDownCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe down action triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeUpCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe up action triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeUpFromSpaceCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe up from spacebar triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeLeftCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe left triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeLeftFromSpaceCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe left from spacebar triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeRightCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe right triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeRightFromSpaceCustomizable
methods.description: Tests that a configurable swipe right from spacebar triggers clearing the input.

methods.name: testSwipeForActionNoneConfigurable
methods.description: Verifies that setting 'none' as the swipe action results in no primary key code.

methods.name: testSwipeForActionNextAlphabetConfigurable
methods.description: Verifies that the 'next alphabet' action sets the primary key code accordingly.

methods.name: testSwipeForActionNextSymbolsConfigurable

methods.name: testSwipeForActionCycleKeyboardsConfigurable
